text:
priya_support: Hey team — onboarding for Evergreen Labs. They accepted the org invite and completed the billing screen but they don't see an API key in the console. Customer says the UI shows "Provisioning completed" but no key value is present. ticket #INC-3492.

ben_devex: ugh, seen that before. did they use SSO or email invite?

priya_support: email invite. account id acct_evgrn_0042. we walked them through logging out/in and clearing cache. nothing.

onboard-bot: Organization acct_evgrn_0042: invite accepted, billing_confirmed=true, provisioning_task=queued -> completed (2024-11-10T16:04:12Z)

carlos_oncall: can you grab the provisioning logs? i'll check the background job. request the ID from their session if possible.

priya_support: got a console trace id from them: trace=trace_0a7f3c. attaching snippet they copied from browser console: 

  POST /api/console/provision 200  (body: {"org":"acct_evgrn_0042"})
  GET /api/console/key 500  (request_id=abc123xyz)

ben_devex: 500 when fetching key after successful provision usually indicates the key record failed to persist. could be a race between provisioning service and keygen-worker. pinging eng. @irene_eng

irene_eng: on it. looking at backend logs for acct_evgrn_0042. i see a 502 from provision-service right at the time the worker tried to create the key:

  [2024-11-10T16:04:12Z] provision-service error: upstream response: 502 Bad Gateway (request_id=abc123xyz)
  stack: connect_timeout -> retry -> give_up

irene_eng: so UI marked provisioning completed because the org row was created, but the downstream keygen call failed before db commit. that matches the symptom.

priya_support: customer needs a usable API key now. what's the workaround?

irene_eng: we can manually generate a key and attach it to the org. two options: (1) use admin console to create key, (2) run admin API from oncall box. i'll give steps.

ben_devex: please share the admin curl snippet so support can do it and hand off.

irene_eng: ok here's a safe one-liner (internal only):

```
curl -s -X POST "https://admin.internal.redwood/api/v1/keys" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_SERVICE_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"org_id":"acct_evgrn_0042","scopes":["generate","embed"],"note":"manual-provision-support-INC-3492"}'
```

irene_eng: response will be JSON with key value and key_id. paste to customer over secure step. mark as created_by=support.

pamela_sales: pls confirm we should expose the key to the customer now? they're blocked in POC. sales is pushing for fast resolution.

irene_eng: yes, safe. key creation doesn't require billing changes. make sure to rotate once provisioning bug fixed. also add a ticket comment explaining manual creation.

priya_support: will do. performing manual create now.

(5 minutes later)

priya_support: created key and shared to customer via encrypted email. they verified it works with a quick call — generation OK, embeddings fine. marking ticket as workaround-provided. :white_check_mark: 

irene_eng: root cause summary: provision-service occasionally returns 502 on the keygen call during high load; org creation succeeded but key persistence failed. reproducer steps: create org + accept billing in a tight loop with network fault injection. saw ~0.7% failure rate in staging.

irene_eng: fix plan: (1) add retry with idempotency token on keygen call (2) make UI poll key existence and show "key pending" state instead of "Provisioning completed" until key confirmed (3) add alert on 5xx rate > 0.5% for keygen.

ben_devex: do you want me to add a short KB for support about the manual admin flow and the fields to fill?

priya_support: please, that would be helpful. include the exact curl and admin UI path so L2 can handle without eng.

irene_eng: created ENG-7124 to implement retry + UI change. i'll link to the ticket in the support case.

priya_support: linking now in INC-3492 and closing with workaround. follow-ups: eng to deploy fix next sprint, devex to create KB. thanks all. :pray:

carlos_oncall: logging note — if this reappears, include request_id from the 500/502 response and the provision task id. those are the fastest traces for me.

priya_support: noted. closing thread.
